programme.title: The Fourth Party
programme.desc: Sophie Williams, the pregnant daughter of a billionaire chief, is on the verge of being duped and killed in exchange for all her inheritance after trusting the wrong people.

programme.title: Shades Of Love
programme.desc: The constant argument between a young couple threatens to break their bond, leaving them wondering if love is enough.

programme.title: AMC Red Carpet - Loving Itohan
programme.desc: AMC Red Carpet moments brings you exclusive red carpet interviews with Nollywood stars at the premieres of top Nollywood movies and other industry events such as award ceremonies.

programme.title: Slow Burn
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A mother-in-law joins forces with her non-confrontational daughter-in-law to chase away the desperate ex-lover who is about to ruin her son.

programme.title: Situationship
programme.desc: Trapped in a toxic engagement, Oluchi’s world is turned upside down when her new neighbour, Brad, offers her refuge. As their bond grows, she must choose between enduring pain and risking everything for love and freedom.

programme.title: Coincidental Love
programme.desc: In the quest of getting a man to impress her nosy sister and brother in-law, Pearl gets entangled with Kennedy, who pretends to be Pearl's blind date, Jerry, someone she has hired to help her out. When Pearl finds out this lie, she kicks Kennedy out of her house but they keep crossing paths.

programme.title: Private Matters
programme.desc: When swinging couple, Angela and Michael, move into a new neighborhood, their promiscuous lifestyle becomes a sick charade and spins out of control.

programme.title: Green
programme.desc: After years of being alone, believing they have missed out on love, two people, who are old in years but young at heart, find each other.

programme.title: One Crazy Day
programme.desc: An airport luggage mix-up causes a chance meeting between Pamela and Lawrence, which leads to connections and consequences that changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Legal Love
programme.desc: A lawyer and a company owner's son navigate a complex relationship, initially marked by tension. Their connection unexpectedly deepens, while a hidden agenda threatens their burgeoning romance.

programme.title: Along Came Love
programme.desc: Worried that some illegalities are going on in her father’s company, a lady goes undercover to investigate and uncover the truth and finds herself in an entanglement she didn’t see coming.

programme.title: Everybody Business
programme.desc: Tired of her brother constantly sab otaging her relationships, Stella decides to find something to keep him busy but her plans backfires.

programme.title: Newly Singles
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Hilda and Obinna instantly bond over the fact that they were both dumped unexpectedly by their respective partners, on the same weekend. Their commiseration turns into a mission when they see that their exes have happily moved on to new romances via social media. Desperate to win their loves back, they hatch up a plan to put an end to their exes' new relationships and send them running back to their arms.

programme.title: Family Friends
programme.desc: The feud between two families has a devastating effect on the relationship between two best friends.

programme.title: Greed
programme.desc: A young man's plan for marriage is thwarted due to him being unemployed and not having a home of his own. Whilst this is going on he is pressured by his family to take more responsibility for his life.

programme.title: A Perfect Girlfriend
programme.desc: When being friends with benefits is no longer enough, what do you do? A woman falls in love with her male best friend but has to watch him dating other women.

programme.title: My Baby Mama
programme.desc: Tony's perfect life is derailed when his old girlfriend, Dami, shows up unannounced at his doorstep with a surprise in tow.

programme.title: Hidden Feeling
programme.desc: A tenant's unpaid rent creates unexpected tension, leading to misunderstandings and surprising confrontations.

programme.title: Unintentional Murder
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Christian and Olivia, a married couple, are torn apart when Olivia catches Christian having an affair with her younger sister, Sophia. This revelation leads to fatal results, but it is soon discovered that things are not quite what they seem.

programme.title: Sweet Pain
programme.desc: A man working hard to provide for his family faces conflict with his girlfriend when she tries to come in between him and his friend and business partner.

programme.title: The Guest
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. When Seyi and Mabel lose their daughter in a car accident, Seyi blames Mabel for her death causing their marriage to suffer. They start to see a therapist and just when things seem to be getting better, Mabel quits on their marriage and moves away. Seyi starts a new relationship but a chance meeting with Mabel has him questioning his new life.

programme.title: Vague
programme.desc: The strained relationship between Daniel and Melody gets worse when he invites his recently widowed friend, Dozie, to move in with them temporarily. Things start to fall apart when Dozie starts to comfort Melody due to Daniel's neglect.

programme.title: Man On Fire
programme.desc: A story of betrayals, a love triangle, passions, an unplanned pregnancy and deceptions.

programme.title: Blood Rivalry
programme.desc: The long-standing rivalry between two brothers erupts when they arrive at their mother’s birthday with their respective fiancees in tow, only to discover hidden truths that change everything.

programme.title: Love Lost and Found
programme.desc: When Mr Dan sees sparks fly between hard-working Chinwe and his seemingly useless son Dave, he decides to dig deeper to find out why there is hostility between them and uses the opportunity to teach his son a lesson.

programme.title: Little Lies
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Ruth, a young widow, finds out about her husband’s other wife when she visits the morgue to claim his body. She is confused about this situation and confronts the mystery woman, where she finds out that her husband has two names and two different identities. The mystery continues when she discovers his phone keeps getting messages in different languages. She resolves to taking the matter to the DSS but is dismissed, causing her to go to the press but she is suddenly threatened by unknown gunmen and asked to run away forever.

programme.title: AMC Music Moments - Playlist 502
programme.desc: AMC presents music from the latest African artists.

programme.title: The Rich And The Poor
programme.desc: A young man's choices create unexpected conflict and tension with his family, with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: The Weekend
programme.desc: A woman discovers a heart-breaking secret. She plans a steamy intimate weekend with her husband, but this weekend is full of questions, anger, rage and blood. She will not stop until she gets her answers.

programme.title: Life As A Single Mom Ep8
programme.desc: Having terminated two pregnancies for Lanre, Grace refuses to abort a third pregnancy for the man she has devoted her best years to, especially when she believes they are destined to get married. But everything takes a devastating turn when Lanre gives her an ultimatum: choose between him and their unborn child. When Grace chooses her baby, Lanre breaks his promise of marriage, leaving her to face an uncertain future alone.

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Cobb
programme.desc: In a back and forth 3 round bout, undefeated lightweight prospect Justin Gaethje (8-0) takes on MMA veteran Brian Cobb (20-7) at WSOF 3, 2013.

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Firmino
programme.desc: In the WSOFNYC main event, undefeated lightweight kingpin Justin The Highlight Gaethje (16-0) defends his crown against Luiz Buscape Firmino (19-7). WSOFNYC featured an unprecedented New Years Eve world championship extravaganza at The Theater at Madison Square Garden in New York City.

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Foster
programme.desc: In the lightweight championship main event, undefeated champ Justin Gaethje (15-0) attempts to defend his throne against Brian Foster (26-8) at WSOF 29, 2016.

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Guillard
programme.desc: In the peoples main event, undefeated contedner and fan favorite Justin Gaethje (12-0) takes on Melvin Guillard (32-13-2) in a catchweight bout at WSOF 15, 2014. The hostility between the two fighters during fight week made this the most anticipated bout of the weekend.

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Lauzon
programme.desc: In his third fight in the WSOF, undefeated knockout artist Justin Gaethje (9-0) accepts the challenge from MMA veteran Dan Lauzon (17-4) at WSOF 6, 2013.

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Newell
programme.desc: The first ever WSOF lightweight king Justin Gaethje (11-0) attempts his first title defense against undefeated contender Nick Newell (11-0) at WSOF 11, 2014.

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Palomino 1
programme.desc: In what many consider one of the best fights in the history of WSOF, and the Fight of the Year for 2015, lightweight champ Justin Gaethje (13-0) faces Luis Palomino (23-9) in an epic battle. Gaethje vs Palomino in the main event of WSOF 19, 2015.

programme.title: Full Fights: Justin Gaethje
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Full Fight: Gaethje v. Palomino 2
programme.desc: In a rematch of one of the best fights in WSOF history, undefeated lightweight champ Justin Gaethje (14-0) attempts to defend his belt against Luis Palomino (23-10) for the second time. Gaethje vs Palomino 2 in the main event of WSOF 23, 2015.

programme.title: PFL in 60 - 2026 PFL Austin
programme.desc: PFL Austin featured Johnny Eblen vs. Impa Kasanganay for the interim middleweight title in the main event, plus Lewis McGrillen vs. Rafael do Nascimento in a bantamweight co-main event.

programme.title: PFL in 60 - 2026 PFL Washington D.C.
programme.desc: PFL Washington D.C. featured Thad Jean vs. late replacement Ernesto Rodriguez for the vacant welterweight title in the main event, plus Tyson Pedro vs. Rafael Xavier in the light heavyweight co-main event.

programme.title: PFL in 60 - 2026 PFL San Diego
programme.desc: PFL San Diego featured California standout AJ McKee vs. undefeated Salamat Isbulaev in the featherweight main event, plus former PFL champion Liz Carmouche taking on Viviane Araujo in the co-main event.

programme.title: PFL in 60 - 2026 PFL MENA 10
programme.desc: PFL MENA 10 in Riyadh featured Saudi star Hattan Alsaif vs. Dania Ouhachi in the catchweight main event, plus Hazem Kayyali vs. Hassan Shaaban in a welterweight tournament showdown.

programme.title: PFL in 60 - 2026 PFL Tampa
programme.desc: Cris Cyborg faces Ketlen Vieira, while Gadzhi Rabadanov takes on Tracy Reeder in Tampa.

programme.desc: Usman Nurmagomedov battles Archie Colgan, with Dakota Ditcheva also in action in New York.

programme.desc: Relive PFL MENA 11 in 60 minutes, featuring Mostafa Rashed Nada vs. Osama ElSeady in Riyadh.

programme.desc: Relive PFL Chicago in 60 minutes, featuring Liz Carmouche vs. Jena Bishop and Timur Khizriev vs. Gabriel Braga.

programme.desc: Ten years after a meteor collides into Earth causing a worldwide flood, a lonely rancher named Liam lives a quiet, private life on his farm away from others. One day while on a hunt, Liam finds Olivia, a troubled young lady, running for her life on the outskirts of his fields.

programme.desc: When neighbours John and Levi witness supernatural events in their Los Angeles apartment, they realise documenting the paranormal could inject some fame and fortune into their wasted lives.

programme.desc: Earth has fallen! A small team of humans are stranded on an alien planet, light years from home. They must work together to battle aliens and activate a machine that will restore earth to a time before it was destroyed.

programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target.

programme.title: The Intergalactic Adventures of Max Cloud
programme.desc: When video-game enthusiast, Sarah (Isabelle Allen), is transported into her favorite game, she finds herself on an intergalactic prison, home to the most dangerous villains in the galaxy.

programme.desc: Tuck, Munch and Alex are a trio of inseparable friends who long for adventure. One day the boys find a cryptic signal on their phones and convinced that it is part of something bigger they set out on a quest to find the source.

programme.title: Time Loop
programme.desc: A young Londoner scientist running experiments with his father in a quite Italian village, has to face the consequences of choices he hasn't made yet.

programme.sub-title: S04 : E03 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 3, Lithuania
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E04 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 4, Holland
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E05 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 5, Serbia
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E06 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 6, Canada (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E07 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 7, Canada (Part 2)
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E08 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E09 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E10 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E11 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 11, Romania
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E12 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 12, Curacao
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E13 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 13, Jordan
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E14 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 14, Greece
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E15 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E16 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E01 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 1, Norway - World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E02 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 2, Germany - FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E03 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 3, Abu Dhabi
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E04 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E05 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E06 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 6, Finland
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E07 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E08 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 8, Finland - U105 (Part 1)
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E09 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 9, Finland - U105 (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E10 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 10, Romania (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E11 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 11, Romania (Part 2)
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E12 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 12, Curacao (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E13 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 13, Curacao (Part 2)
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E14 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E15 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 15, Mexico - World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E16 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 16, Mexico - World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E01 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 1, World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E02 SCL S6 Ep2 FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E03 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 3, Turkey
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E04 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E05 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E06 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 6, Russia
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E07 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E08 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E09 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target.

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: Set in New Orleans, this is the story of a mysterious man, Nick Easter. Nick gets himself not only on the jury of a landmark case against a gun manufacturer, but as the foreman, in an attempt to influence the other jury members to vote a certain way.

programme.title: 16 Blocks
programme.desc: They chose the worst man for the job. They expected him to fail, but he wasn't about to let a witness be murdered on his watch. Personal demons put Jack a New York City cop at rock bottom.

programme.title: The Ex Next Door
programme.desc: A happy couple’s life turns upside down when the husband’s ex-girlfriend moves in next door.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: "Match Point" is a drama about ambition, the seduction of wealth, love, and sexual passion. Perhaps most importantly, however, the story reveals the huge part luck plays in events, refuting the comforting misconception that more of life is under our control than really is.

programme.title: Dying for the Crown
programme.desc: Isabelle reunites with Andrea, the former classmate who once attacked her out of jealousy. Andrea seems changed and bonds with Isabelle’s daughter, but her friendship is a ruse. She is secretly plotting revenge and intends to destroy Isabelle’s life.

programme.title: Strictly Confidential
programme.desc: A haunted young woman finds herself drawn into a world of seduction, duplicity and betrayal as she desperately tries to uncover the mystery surrounding her best friend's suicide.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2
programme.desc: Years after Ray Breslin fought his way out of the escape-proof prison called "The Tomb," he's organized a new top-notch, for-hire security force. But when one of his team members goes missing he must now decipher a way to break into the world's best hidden prison...

programme.title: Submarine
programme.desc: When a submarine gets trapped underwater, the crew must figure out how the get free, and if it was a case of sabotage.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: SURVIVOR is a gripping thriller about State Department employee Kate Abbott, newly posted in the American embassy in London. Kate is charged with stopping terrorists from getting into the U.S. which puts her directly in the line of fire.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: Full of shock turns, moments of horrific injury, polar bear action and tense emotional scenes, Arctic will keep your hands clenched to your chair until its brilliant, breathless conclusion.

programme.title: Dark Minds
programme.desc: A twisted psychological thriller about a man haunted by his past.

programme.title: Left Behind: Rise of the Antichrist
programme.desc: After millions of people vanish and the world falls into chaos, the only light is a charismatic new leader who rises to become head of the U.N. But does he bring hope for a better future? Or is it the end of the world?

programme.title: Winter Ridge
programme.desc: A young detective is torn apart after his wife ends up in a coma. Unable to accept her condition, he throws himself into a manhunt chasing a serial killer whose motives are connected to his wife.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: Radio astronomer Zane Zaminsky (Charlie Sheen) believes he's picked up a cosmic noise that signals extraterrestrial intelligence. His desperate search for answers leads him to Mexico and a mysterious power plant, where is arrested for the murder of a scientist.

programme.title: Flight 7500
programme.desc: A flight from Los Angeles to Tokyo is rocked by turbulence—and a terrifying force is unleashed in this spine-chilling journey into fear from the director of The Grudge.

programme.title: Bonhoeffer
programme.desc: Bonhoeffer: Pastor. Spy. Assassin. As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, Dietrich Bonhoeffer is swept into the epicenter of a deadly plot to assassinate Hitler.

programme.title: Peacock
programme.desc: John Skillpa, a quiet bank clerk living in tiny Peacock, Nebraska, prefers to live an invisible life. This might have to do with John’s secret: he has another personality no one knows about, a woman who each morning cooks him breakfast before he starts his day. Then, in a moment, everything changes.

programme.title: Wire Room
programme.desc: Bruce Willis stars in this explosive thriller as a federal agent caught in chaos when a rookie in Homeland Security’s Wire Room crosses a cartel arms dealer. With corrupt cops, a rogue guard, and a deadly SWAT team closing in, they must fight to survive and expose a conspiracy.

programme.title: Knowing
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage stars in KNOWING, a gripping action-thriller of global proportions about a professor who stumbles on terrifying predictions about the future and sets out to prevent them from coming true. Rose Byrne and Lara Robinson also star in director Alex Proyas' riveting feature.

programme.title: Sin City 2: A Dame to Kill For
programme.desc: In a town where justice doesn't prevail, the desperate want vengeance and ruthless murderers find themselves with vigilantes on their heels. Their paths cross in Sin City’s famous Kadie's Club Pecos.

programme.title: Her Boyfriend's Secret
programme.desc: INSPIRED BY TRUE EVENTS - Renowned interior designer Melissa is drawn into a relationship with a man who has a secret life -- another wife and family. She soon meets another innocent victim and learns her man is more than duplicitous, he’s a killer!

programme.title: Lethal Admirer
programme.desc: When Megan’s fiancé is brutally killed, she moves cross-country to rebuild her life. She’s followed months later by former co-worker Lloyd and when they meet up “by chance,” he still wants to escape the friend zone and become much more.

programme.title: Jimmy P
programme.desc: A troubled Native American veteran forms an extraordinary friendship with his maverick French psychoanalyst as they try to find a cure to his suffering.

programme.title: The Hole
programme.desc: From director Joe Dante comes a family-friendly adventure that explores the fears and secrets buried in the mind of kids.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: One mistake will change everything. For one family protecting their land on the Texas-Mexico border is everything but one night when confronted with an immigrant family illegally crossing the border Jackson accidentally kills a young boy.

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: Alderney, UK. 1964. A telephone operator ends up being the pivotal piece of a drama unfurling which puts professional integrity, and relationships, to the test.

programme.title: Amish Abduction
programme.desc: Amish wife and mother Annie faces a crisis when her husband leaves the word of the Amish to live among “normal Americans,” or the “English” as the Amish dub them. But things turn even more dire when her husband returns, seeking custody of their son, and is willing to kill to achieve his goal…

programme.title: A Christmas Gamble
programme.desc: A former gambling addict needs $60,000 to save his mother from nursing home eviction. He's never lost a bet on Christmas. Is this the Christmas miracle he's been waiting for?

programme.title: Paradise Hills
programme.desc: A young woman named Uma (Emma Roberts) wakes one morning in Paradise Hills, where well-off families send their daughters to become the perfect version of themselves. But behind all this "perfection" lies a sinister secret. Milla Jovovich also stars.

programme.title: An Imperfect Murder
programme.desc: An Imperfect Murder is a cat and mouse thriller which will leave you guessing until the very end – staring Sienna Miller and Alec Baldwin.

programme.title: The Whole Truth
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves is a defense attorney trying to clear a teen in the brutal stabbing of his father. As more evidence comes to light, the whole truth seems darker than ever.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: An up-and-coming district attorney takes on the case of a young woman who has accused three men of sexual assault. She puts her career on the line in order to uncover a deeper web of mystery, murder and deception.

programme.title: Away From Her
programme.desc: A double-Oscar-nominated, beautifully subtle exploration of Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: The Legend Of Hercules
programme.desc: In the epic origin story the legend of Hercules, a half-god, half-man blessed with extraordinary streng. Betrayed by his stepfather, the king, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers.

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: It is 1914. As the Great War looms, the mighty Ottoman Empire is crumbling. Constantinople, the once vibrant, multicultural capital on the shores of the Bosporus, is about to be consumed by chaos.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: In the wake of a painful estrangement from his daughter, boxing trainer Frankie Dunn has been unwilling to let himself get close to anyone for a very long time – then Maggie Fitzgerald walks into his gym.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Based on the true story of one of Miami’s most notorious businessmen and gangster's, SPEED KILLS is a high-octane thriller, described as “The Wolf of Wall Street on Water.”

programme.title: Fruitvale Station
programme.desc: When 22-year-old Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan) wakes up on December 31, 2008, he’s ready to begin working on his resolution to change his ways and be a better son, boyfriend and father. Although change can be difficult, his hard work starts to pay off.

programme.title: Conan The Barbarian
programme.desc: The most legendary Barbarian of all time is back. A quest that begins as a personal vendetta for the fierce Cimmerian warrior soon turns into an epic battle against hulking rivals, horrific monsters, and impossible odds, as Conan realizes he is the only hope of saving the great nations of Hyboria.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: When a group of cold-blooded criminals led by Elias (Ben Mendelsohn) and Jonah (Cam Gigandet), invade the Miller mansion in a vicious home invasion, Kyle Miller (Nicolas Cage) must battle his personal demons before saving his wife and daughter.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Former CIA spy takes on his toughest assignment to date: looking after his girlfriend's three kids.

programme.title: The Light Between Oceans
programme.desc: Based on the bestselling novel by M.L. Stedman and from acclaimed director Derek Cianfrance, The Light Between Oceans is a beautiful and heart-breaking reminder of the infinite power of love and the lengths that we’ll go to in order to protect it.

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Rex is based on the true-life story of young Marine Corporal Megan Leavey whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.

programme.title: Diana
programme.desc: Celebrated and adored by millions, she was the Queen of people’s hearts, yet the bittersweet story of the last man to truly capture hers has never before. In a story that until now has remained untold, Diana introduces a time in the Princess’s life that was important in shaping her final years...

programme.title: Birth of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the world of martial arts, there is one man above all: Bruce Lee. San Francisco, 1965.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Five young people find themselves stranded in Moscow, fighting to survive in the wake of a devastating alien attack.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: FBI agent Malcolm Turner is known best for being a brilliant, master of disguise. Malcolm's latest assignment sends him to small-town Georgia, where he's assigned to trap a brutal bank robber who the FBI suspects will be coming down to visit his ex-girlfriend Sherry and her son.

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: Spencer Aimes is just your average, undercover, super-assassin accustomed to a life of flashy sports cars and even flashier women. But when he meets Jen Kornfeldt, a fun-loving computer tech, he finds true love… and happily trades international intrigue for domestic bliss.

programme.title: The Railway Man
programme.desc: Eric Lomax was one of thousands of Allied prisoners of war forced to work on the construction of the Thai/Burma railway during WW2. Years later, he met Patti and fell in love. Discovering that the young Japanese officer who haunted her husband was still alive, she faced a terrible decision.

programme.title: I Love You Phillip Morris
programme.desc: A cop turns con man once he comes out of the closet. Once imprisoned, he meets the second love of his life, whom he'll stop at nothing to be with.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: In the not too distant future, a drifter travelling through the desert discovers the largest gold nugget ever found. He must guard it from thieves amid harsh conditions and wild dogs while waiting for his partner to return.

programme.title: She's The Man
programme.desc: Viola (Amanda Bynes), disguised as her twin brother, joins the high school boys' soccer team and helps win the big game while unexpectedly falling for Duke (Channing Tatum) the hot star forward.

programme.title: Still Alice
programme.desc: Alice Howland, happily married with three grown children, is a renowned linguistics professor who starts to forget words. When she receives a devastating diagnosis, Alice and her family find their bonds tested.

programme.title: Love Sarah
programme.desc: Three generations of women, led by Mimi will need to overcome grief, doubts and differences to honour the memory of their beloved Sarah, while embarking on a journey to establish a new bakery in Notting Hill, a place filled with love, hope and colourful pastries from all over the world.

programme.title: The Grand Seduction
programme.desc: Brendan Gleeson is Murray, a once proud fisherman who now, along with his former colleagues in the harbour of Tickle Head are out of work and forced to live off welfare.

programme.title: Zookeeper
programme.desc: In this warm-hearted comedy, the animals at one particular zoo love their caretaker, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James). But when Griffin decides the only way he can get a girl in his life is to find a more glamorous job, the animals, in a panic, break their time-honored code of silence...

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: When a star soccer coach is murdered and his priceless Pink Panther diamond stolen, France is in an uproar. Fortunately, Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Steve Martin) is on the case with his trusted partner Gilbert Ponton (Jean Reno). Will he seduce the pop diva, Xania (Beyoncé Knowles)?

programme.title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
programme.desc: Vicky Cristina Barcelona has become one of the most talked about movies of the year. A sizzling, erotically charged, relentlessly hilarious and touching romantic comedy.

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: It is 1914. As the Great War looms, the mighty Ottoman Empire is crumbling. Constantinople, the once vibrant, multicultural capital on the shores of the Bosporus, is about to be consumed by chaos.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: "Match Point" is a drama about ambition, the seduction of wealth, love, and sexual passion. Perhaps most importantly, however, the story reveals the huge part luck plays in events, refuting the comforting misconception that more of life is under our control than really is.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Fortress is an all-out-action cyber thriller from the producers of Lone Survivor and The Irishman and starring the action powerhouse Bruce Willis, Escape Plan II’s Jesse Metcalfe, One Tree Hill’s Chad Michael Murray and Shannen Doherty (90210, Charmed).

programme.title: Tokarev
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage stars in this action-packed thriller as Paul Maguire, a reformed criminal living a simple life as a family man and husband. But Paul is about to discover you can never truly outlive your sins.

programme.title: The Savvy Nomad Phillippines

programme.desc: Luxurious hotels, thrilling water parks, inexpensive food and almost 300 days of bright sunny weather make Bulgaria’s biggest seaside resort, Sunny Beach popular for budget beach getaways. programme.desc: Emily Kaye was not aware of the past dealings of the handsome Patrick Mahon when she fell for him. Mahon would go on to murder her in a bungalow he rented.

programme.title: The Lighthouse Club Murders
programme.desc: Paul Teed murdered three of his family members in a nightclub over a dispute over money. He then fled back to his home in Bradford, believing he had an alibi.

programme.title: The Not So Cunning Fox
programme.desc: Sidney Fox was a dashing 31-year-old man who made a living travelling the country, swindling spinsters out of money and cashing stolen cheques.

programme.title: The Valentine Killer
programme.desc: On Valentine's Day, Paul Dyson strangled his partner Joanne Nelson to death before removing her body and making it look like she had disappeared.

programme.title: The Carbox Killer
programme.desc: Andre Genestin was a cheating husband. A brutal murder followed that would see his wife's body stored in a car roof box in the garden.

programme.title: Enemy Within
programme.desc: When a lawyer was killed, the beating was so violent that the force the killer used left microscopic evidence at the scene which pointed directly to him.

programme.title: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: Two women are found murdered and police believe there may be a serial killer on the loose. Tiny clues offer up a matching link to their killer.

programme.title: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: When a young woman was found dead on a golf course, it would be the distinctive grass of the course that would lead to her killer.

programme.title: Material Witness
programme.desc: When a horse rider goes missing, her body is found a month later. The killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind which pointed to him and him alone.

programme.title: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is killed in his own garage, investigators turn to his wife for answers, and they discover she has a secret to tell.

programme.title: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: Police enlist the help of a sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert to track down the killer of a disc jockey, who was found dead in a community garden.

programme.title: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths proved to be serial murders. The poison the killer used had a unique chemical signature which led police to him.

programme.title: Bump in the Night
programme.desc: The blood splattered scene of a horrendous murder baffles investigators until they find a suspicious shoeprint outside the victim's house.

programme.title: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Investigators analyse shoe impressions found at the scene of a crime. With little other evidence, Michigan police hope it will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Cold Hard Crash
programme.desc: On a cozy couple's getaway to Bucks Lake, California, a young mother is killed in a snowmobile crash. Upon closer inspection, it appears it was no accident.

programme.title: Fatal Fog
programme.desc: In South Carolina, a boat trip with friends turns into an unforgettable nightmare. It's a race against the elements to find a young woman who went overboard.

programme.title: Murder at Moselle, The
programme.desc: In South Carolina, a mother and son are shot and killed on their family's estate. Detectives collect evidence at the scene and the only witness is interviewed.

programme.title: Burned in a Blackout
programme.desc: After Hurricane Ivan wreaks havoc in Alabama, a woman's charred remains are discovered. The investigation falters in the aftermath of the storm.

programme.title: Cruise Control
programme.desc: A young newlywed reports a gust of wind tossed his wife overboard on their cruise. Investigators search through the night to find the bride's body.

programme.title: Timothy Evans - Part 1
programme.desc: Timothy Evans was hanged for murdering his wife and their baby daughter. The witness for the prosecution was his landlord, John Christie.

programme.title: Timothy Evans - Part 2
programme.desc: With Evans hanged for a crime he did not commit, the local death toll of women began to increase - justice would eventually catch up with John Christie.

programme.title: Colin Stagg - Part 1
programme.desc: In 1992, Rachel Nickell was murdered on Wimbledon Common. After the biggest police manhunt in modern history, Colin Stagg was imprisoned for her murder.

programme.title: Colin Stagg - Part 2
programme.desc: With Colin Stagg acquitted, it would take 16 years before a breakthrough in DNA evidence would catch the real killer, Robert Napper.

programme.title: The Acid Bath Murders
programme.desc: While John George Haigh was in prison for fraud, he came up with a plan for the perfect murder: if there was no body, how could he be charged?

programme.title: The Party Killer
programme.desc: Charlotte Pinkney vanished from Ilfracombe after going to a party. Police launched a murder hunt when her handbag was found in undergrowth.

programme.title: The Hotelier and the Hitman
programme.desc: A Bournemouth hotelier called Peter Taylor gets away with murdering his wife; but when he conspires to kill his son-in-law nine years later, his luck runs out.

programme.title: The Shallow Grave
programme.desc: When Danny Dyke tried playing the hardened drug dealer, he found himself in over his head, but it was his murderers who ended up having sleepless nights.

programme.title: The Last Supper
programme.desc: When Michael Barber finds his wife Susan in bed with another man, she realises she has to take drastic measures to stop him leaving.

programme.title: Murdered In The Line Of Duty
programme.desc: Brian Bishop was shot and killed in a shoot-out with an armed robber as they returned to a stash point piled high with stolen cash.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: When Devon Guzman is found with her throat cut, investigators think her girlfriend is to blame, however a jealous love triangle points to the killers.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: When a neighbourhood quarrel boils over, Billy Woodward decides to strike first. Billy crawls across the street and opens fire, killing two and injuring one.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: After being diagnosed with Lyme disease, Neal Zumberge claims his neighbour's deer feeder is to blame. Their feud boils over into murder.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: When Linda Culbertson calls police about an invasion, they assume she is a victim. However, police discover that Linda hired two men to murder her boss.

programme.title: A Deadly Addiction
programme.desc: In 2003, as the area of Hamblen County, Tennessee struggles with the growing opioid crisis, the body of a local woman is discovered.

programme.title: Cold Call Killer
programme.desc: 1990 was supposed to be a time of new beginnings for Sharon Gill. But this would change in a matter of minutes when she was discovered brutally murdered.

programme.title: Carnage at the Creek
programme.desc: In July of 1981 a body of a young local, Ricky Ridings, was discovered shot in the front seat of his truck, and left abandoned in a creek bed.

programme.title: A Killer in the Complex
programme.desc: East Greenbush, New York is shattered in 1994 with the discovery of Wilomeana 'Violet' Filkins' badly beaten body. This was to be the start of a long investigation for police.

programme.title: Butcher in Blythe
programme.desc: The body of a woman is found on a highway. Riverside County Sheriffs have no leads, until years later when anonymous letters are sent to a journalist.

programme.title: Written In Plain Sight
programme.desc: Jason Webster was an undergraduate who became obsessed with mature student, Rebecca Love. When Rebecca rejected his advances, he murdered her in a drunken rage.

programme.title: The Ruxton Murders
programme.desc: Buck Ruxton was a well-respected GP and was greatly admired by his patients. But behind his respectable exterior, there lurked a duplicitous and jealous man.

programme.title: The Campervan Killer
programme.desc: A bizarre murder case began when police attended the scene of a dog barking outside a campervan. Inside, they found its owner - Tony Robinson - murdered.

programme.title: Britain's Worst Female Serial Killer
programme.desc: Despite only being trialled and convicted for the death of a single victim, Mary Ann Cotton is often classed as Britain's worst female serial killer.

programme.title: The Murderous Bigamist
programme.desc: When Pierre LeGris reports his wife Rui Li missing, police are instantly wary. They uncover a tangled web of loyalty and deception.

programme.title: The Blackpool Double Murder
programme.desc: Two eerily similar murders take place 10 years apart: two elderly women are killed in their homes. Could a cut clothesline in each garden unravel this case?

programme.title: The Lady Killer
programme.desc: The murder of an actress triggers a nationwide manhunt for a killer. But whilst Neville Heath is on the run in Bournemouth, another woman is found dead.

programme.desc: In order to set Yuma straight, Shark steals Yuma’s Key! Can Yuma find the courage to face Shark, or will Yuma’s fears leave him cowering for cover?!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The battle between Yuya and his mom kicks into high gear! Can Yuya avoid being grounded, or will Loco Yoko put the pedal to the metal and throttle her way to victory?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: As Zuzu and Yugo try to unravel the riddle of Yuya's dimensional doubles, their sleuthing is cut short by Sector Security!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Zuzu and Yugo redline their Duel Runner in a high-stakes Turbo Duel with Sector Security! Can they outrun the long arm of the law, or will Security put the brakes on their escape?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: When Yuya and his pals arrive in the Synchro Dimension, Sector Security is waiting for them with open arms… and cuffs! Can Yuya smooth things out before Sylvio and Celina put a wrinkle in his plan?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E28 The Darkness Returns — Part 1
programme.desc: Marik brings Joey and himself to the Shadow Realm, where each duelist's heart is linked with his monsters, suffering the pain that the monsters feel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E29 The Darkness Returns — Part 2
programme.desc: Marik's duel tactics eat away at Joey's deck and his life points. Joey's comeback strategy, however is hindered by Marik's new monster on Joey's side of the field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E30 The Darkness Returns — Part 3
programme.desc: With life points dropping and his monsters unable to attack, Joey summons a monster that proves to be his saving grace, prompting Marik to unleash Ra.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E31 The Darkness Returns — Part 4
programme.desc: Despite surviving Marik's onslaught, Joey is weakened by the shadow game's effects and succumbs just as he is about to win the duel. Yugi struggles to find hope after losing his best friend to the Shadow Realm.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E32 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 1
programme.desc: The second duel of the semi-finals begins with Yugi dueling Kaiba for the second spot in the grand final and the chance to duel Marik. Kaiba draws Obelisk on his first turn, but Yugi thwarts his attempts to summon it with Lightforce Sword.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E33 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 2
programme.desc: Kaiba and Yugi compete to summon their monsters to the field, but each is hindered by the other's strategies.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E34 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 3
programme.desc: Kaiba is able to summon Obelisk the Tormentor, to the field, putting it at odds with Yugi's own Slifer the Sky Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E35 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 4
programme.desc: With the destruction of both their monsters, Kaiba and Yugi are presented with a vision of the High Priest's legendary battle against the Pharaoh. Kaiba believes this to be a mere illusion, but Yugi knows that it is a vision of the past. The duel continues with Kaiba and Yugi attacking with their signature cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E36 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 5
programme.desc: Kaiba gains a lead in the duel when he summons three Blue Eyes White Dragons. Yugi's hopes of winning come to an end, but receives some encouragement from Joey and stays strong in the game. Meanwhile, Joey's dreams and the ongoing duel cause Joey to awake.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E37 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 6
programme.desc: Kaiba's final move forces the duelists to use only three cards, forcing to use the best cards in the decks to win the duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E38 Battle for the Bronze — Part 1
programme.desc: Tired of Kaiba's constant ridicule, Joey challenges Kaiba for third place in the Battle City tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E39 Battle for the Bronze — Part 2
programme.desc: Joey manages to gain one of Kaiba's strongest cards to help him advance in the duel. Meanwhile, Téa – possessed by the good half of Marik's soul – fights Yami Marik for control of the Millennium Rod.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E40 Battle for the Bronze — Part 3
programme.desc: After defeating Joey and taking third place in the tournament, Kaiba plans to destroy the Duel Tower and bury his past forever. Ishizu and Mokuba convince him otherwise, and he gives Yugi one all-powerful card that could give him a chance to defeat Marik in the final duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E41 The Final Face Off — Part 1
programme.desc: The final duel of Battle City begins. Yami Marik quickly turns it into a shadow game and sets it up so that if he or the Pharaoh loses, their host's soul will be destroyed. Yugi convinces the Pharaoh not to worry about him and to keep dueling to save Mai, Bakura and the good Marik. Yami Marik quickly discards his Winged Dragon of Ra to the graveyard, planning to revive it. Yugi manages to summon Slifer the Sky Dragon using his three Knights.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E42 The Final Face Off — Part 2
programme.desc: Marik uses Ra's effect to destroy Slifer and revives it once again to attack Yugi. Yugi plays the card Kaiba gave him, Fiend's Sanctuary, to stop Marik's attack. He then uses Multiply in order to summon Obelisk the Tormentor and devastate Marik.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E42 The Final Face Off — Part 2
programme.desc: Marik uses Ra's effect to destroy Slifer and revives it once again to attack Yugi. Yugi plays the card Kaiba gave him, Fiend's Sanctuary, to stop Marik's attack. He then uses Multiply in order to summon Obelisk the Tormentor and devastate Marik.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E43 The Final Face Off — Part 3
programme.desc: Marik's good half possesses Tea again and begs Yugi to destroy him along with his evil side,but he eventually weakens and begins fading away as his dark half loses life points. Yugi and the Pharaoh become hesitant to duel, not wanting to harm the good Marik. As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. In a cliffhanger, Odion is revealed to have been awakened by Marik's apology.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E44 The Final Face Off — Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi continues fending off Marik's attacks, holding out until he has the cards he needs to defeat Marik. Finally, he summons Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl and uses them to activate Ragnarok – a spell card with the ability to destroy all the monsters on Marik's field, including The Winged Dragon of Ra that he fused himself with. (The card actually negates and removes all cards Marik controls, at the cost of banishing all monsters to the graveyard that Yami Yugi has.) But Yami Marik claims that if Ra is destroyed (which will leave the good Marik with only 1 life point), then the good Marik will be too weak to resist the power of the Shadow Realm, and will consequently lose his soul....

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E45 The Final Face Off — Part 5
programme.desc: Odion tries to get the good Marik to resist his evil half. As a result, Yami Marik becomes angered, and attacks Odion with the Millennium Rod, which weakens Odion even more. Odion doesn't give up, despite Ishizu's protests. As Marik continues his onslaught (which begins to injure Odion), Odion tells Marik's good side that together, they had conquered his evil half before, and that they could do it again. Then, he tells the good Marik that since Yami Marik was created by the good Marik's hatred, he has the power to destroy him. As Yami Marik raises the Rod to deliver the final blow, the good Marik disappears from the field, and begins fighting against Yami Marik, who struggles for control...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E46 One for the Road
programme.desc: Yugi and the gang escape from the island in time, but they are forced to leave Kaiba and Mokuba behind. The brothers get away just as the island explodes using the Blue-Eyes White Jet. Yugi's group heads back to Domino City, where they say their farewells and go their separate ways.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E47 Looking Back and Moving Ahead
programme.desc: Téa shows Serenity around the city, to all the sites of the important duels of the Battle City Tournament, while Joey duels Yugi to get his Red-Eyes Black Dragon back. Téa eventually meets up with Yugi, and they head off for further adventures.

programme.sub-title: S04 : E16 On the Wrong Track, Part 1

programme.sub-title: S04 : E18 On the Wrong Track, Part 3

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The train derails and plummets into a chasm, leaving Yugi and Téa totally lost in the Rocky Mountains!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E73 Jodha Akbar S4 E73
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E36 A King and His Queen S2 E36
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!
